turns.question: How many euros more did a social lead cost us than a search lead in September 2026?
turns.answer: Cost per lead (EUR) for 1-30 September 2026 was 52.50 EUR for social and 42.07 EUR for search; the semantic layer has no metric for the gap between channels, so I give both figures rather than computing a difference myself. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
